claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: BMS-299897 is a gamma-secretase inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines, as gamma-secretase inhibition is not cytotoxic and no class in the vocabulary shares a gamma-secretase-mediated killing pattern.
